observed.facings.png: Three offline scenes at one shared scale: south (tall), east (wide), north (tall). Each scene has a brown ground plane, a flat dark pit rectangle and the steel drawbridge leaf standing raised at one bank, with pairs of small grey/black bollards that have yellow hazard bands. Each bollard has a small grey rope coil lying beside its foot. There is no taut or arched rope anywhere.
observed.south.png: The raised leaf is a riveted steel panel with diagonal braces. It stands upright with its hinge bar on the far (upper) bank. The dark pit sits below it, and two bollards stand on the near bank at the bottom. At 6x zoom each bollard has a squashed elliptical rope coil on the ground right in front of its foot. The far edge of the coil touches the post base and nothing passes behind the post. Two turns show slightly offset from each other, and a short loose end runs out at the lower front of each coil. The rope is thin and grey-dark, like painted steel cable. The coil is somewhat regular but not a single clean hoop.
observed.east.png: Side scene. The raised leaf is seen edge-on as a thin vertical steel strip on the left bank at the pit edge. Two bollards stand on each bank. Each has a flat elliptical coil lying on the ground beside its foot, on the side toward the pit. Each coil shows about one and a half overlapping turns and a loose end crossing out of the coil. On the left bank the loose ends stick a few pixels past the ring's right edge toward the leaf strip but do not touch it. The right-bank coils' tails point left toward the open pit side. The coils sit well inboard of the pit edge, and none lies over the pit.
observed.north.png: The raised leaf is seen from its riveted back face, standing in the pit with its hinge at the near (lower) edge. Bollard pairs stand on both banks. Upper-bank pair: the coils lie in front of the post feet, each a squashed ellipse with two turns and a loose end trailing out at the lower right or left. Lower-bank pair: the same treatment as in south. All four coils lie flat on the ground. No hoop stands up, nothing floats at head height, and no coil shows at the edges of the leaf.
observed.scale.png: The lowered state at rotation E with a vanilla human for scale. The bollards are about knee height on the human. Thin taut steel cables run from each bollard to the deck edges. The cable thickness is the reference that the slack coils match closely.
observed.assembled_1.png: Rotation W, raised. A mirror of east: the leaf strip stands on the right bank at the pit edge. All four bollards have ground coils with loose ends. The right-bank tails point left toward the leaf strip but stop short of it. Everything stays on the ground with no rope over the pit.
observed.assembled_2.png: Lowered N, for context: four bollards with thin taut cables running vertically into the deck's hazard-striped edges. The bollard art matches the raised scenes.

CAMERA.seen: The bollards are drawn in the building camera with a lit top and front band. The coils are squashed ellipses lying in the ground plane, not circles facing the camera and not upright arcs.

BORE.seen: Solid rope only. There is no pipe or hose with an open bore.

PORTS.seen: In the raised state each rope runs from its own bollard's foot or front into the coil. In lowered context (scale, assembled_2) each cable meets its bollard head and the deck edge.

PORTS_DRAWN.seen: Each bollard has exactly one rope in every rotation. All are disconnected and coiled when raised, and there are no extra connectors.

LAYERS.seen: In S and N the coils lie in front of the post feet and nothing is drawn across the post base. Coils behind the leaf (N upper bank) sit inboard and do not show at the leaf edges. The leaf draws over the pit correctly.

ROTATIONS.seen: The same bollard, coil style, rope thickness and palette appear in S, E, N and W. The height spread comes from the scene canvas (a tall N/S pit scene against a wide E/W scene), not from a change in the subject.

SIGNATURE.seen: With the leaf raised, the ropes are clearly disconnected and lying slack on the bank as coils with a loose end. No hooks or arches stand above the bollards.

MATERIAL.seen: The rope is grey and dark with highlights, cut from the bollard's painted steel cable. It reads as wire rope, the same thickness as the lowered cable.

FOOTPRINT.seen: Each coil stays beside its bollard on the bank, inside the anchor area, and never over the pit.

ALPHA.seen: The scene ground and pit are context backdrops in an offline render. The coils themselves have no halo or painted cast shadow.

OURS.seen: Procedural rope cut from the project's own bollard rope. No donor art.

OWNER_NOTES.seen: 'Slack and disconnected': all ropes lie coiled on the ground, attached to nothing. C6 true perspective plane: the coils are ground-plane ellipses squashed vertically, with no upright hoop.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px/cell a coil shrinks to a small grey loop smudge at each bollard foot. That is enough to read 'rope on the ground, not attached', but the loose end and second turn will vanish (advisory).

MATERIAL.seen: Light and dark grey braid strands read as twisted rope or wire, not flat paint.

FOOTPRINT.seen: The coils stay on the bank next to their bollards and never reach over the pit. The 67% height spread comes from the context canvas size (960 vs 576 px render frames), not from the subject.

LEGIBLE.seen: At a quarter scale each coil becomes an approximately 8 px grey oval beside a 4 px bollard. It reads as rope lying on the ground, though the loose end and inner turn vanish at that size.
